meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按「痛点引入—产品介绍—卖点阐述—情感召唤」四段结构，为你生成或改写电商商品文案，产出带 emoji 的标题和 Markdown 正文，并控制 emoji 占比。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或优化需求，或要为商品做营销图片文案时接管，涵盖智能家居、数码配件等品类。

say.text: 帮我给这款智能睡眠眼罩写一段电商文案，卖点是科学遮光
say.note: 会先询问产品名称、价格、卖点等信息再动笔

say.text: 把这段商品文案的标题加上 emoji，突出核心卖点
say.note: 按「emoji+产品昵称+核心卖点」格式改写标题

say.text: 帮我优化这段文案的痛点和卖点描述
say.note: 会逐段分析问题点并给出改写版本

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes or rewrites e-commerce product copy in a four-part structure: pain point, product intro, selling points, emotional close, with an emoji headline and Markdown body.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for e-commerce copy creation or optimization, or need marketing image copy for products such as smart-home or digital-accessory items.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for this smart sleep mask; key selling point is light blocking
say_en.note: Asks for product name, price and selling points first

say_en.text: Add emoji to this product headline and highlight the main selling point
say_en.note: Rewrites it as emoji + product nickname + selling point

say_en.text: Improve the pain point and selling point parts of this copy
say_en.note: Reviews each section and returns a rewrite
